bio.text: Scott Singer is the Republican nominee for Florida's 25th Congressional District in 2026, running against Rep. Jared Moskowitz.
He was first elected to the Boca Raton City Council in 2014 and was elected mayor in 2018, serving three terms.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard University in 1998 and a law degree from Georgetown Law in 2003, and his career experience includes working as an attorney and small business owner.
